summary.text: Andrew Prout is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 13 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a software engineer who lives in Hudson, New Hampshire.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Prout lives in Hudson, New Hampshire, and earned a B.S. in information technology security from Western Governors University in 2012, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a systems engineer at RS Information Systems and as an IT security engineer and an HPC systems engineer at the MIT Lincoln Laboratory.
Ballotpedia lists Prout's House tenure as beginning in 2016, and he has represented Hillsborough 13 since the 2022 election.
He was assigned to the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee for the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
